info.name: IdCard Web Service (IdCardWS) Campus Term API

description.content:
IdCard Web Service (IdCardWS) provides a RESTful API to UW IdCard data. Subscribe to http://mailman.u.washington.edu/mailman/listinfo/idcardws-users to get notifications about planned outages, support and the announcement of new features.

Contact Support:
 Name: Enterprise Web Services & Events Team
 Email: idcardws-support@uw.edu
